description: Rename a collection's display name and/or noun (e.g. key 'posts' shown as 'Recipes' / 'recipe'): cosmetic, separate from the tag that defines membership; no publish needed. At least one of name/noun. null (or "") resets that field to its default; omitting it keeps the current value.

key.description: Collection key exactly as list_collections gave it, e.g. "posts" or "blog/" (a typed key may 404 or be normalized).

name.description: Display name (≤80 chars). null resets to the derived name.

noun.description: Singular noun for one item, e.g. "post" (≤40 chars). null resets to the derived noun.

name: update_collection
